statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
These symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
CPT code 93229 (continuous mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered
The service was denied under CO-197 for absent prior authorization
